run_autoround_quantize: run AutoRound quantization on a pretrained model with 4-bit symmetric group-wise quantization on CPU
run_autoround_quantize_and_save: run AutoRound quantize_and_save to quantize a model and save it to disk in auto_round format
test_autoround_default_accuracy: test the default accuracy of AutoRound quantization by comparing two quantized model outputs
test_autoround_3bit_asymmetric: test 3-bit asymmetric AutoRound quantization on a tiny OPT model and save the result
review_autoround_init: review the AutoRound constructor parameters including bits, group_size, sym, device, iters, seqlen, and dataset
